_what: Shopify page handles that changed, and the handle each one now redirects to.
_why: A renamed handle looks exactly like a deleted one to any check that compares link sets by string. tools/ap-cyber-ced/generate-practice-restyle.js refuses a generated body that drops a link the live page carries, which is the right rule and the whole point of a MERGE guard, and on 2026-09-08 it refused a correct body: the Unit 1 practice hub still carries the terminal lab's OLD handle, the generator emits the new one, and the rule read a repoint as a deletion. A rename is not a deletion and nothing in the repo said so.
_bounds: This forgives a lost link ONLY when the rename's target is present in the new body. Dropping the link entirely still fails, which is what keeps this a fact rather than an escape hatch.
_lifecycle: A row can be pruned once every live body has been repointed and the fixtures under smoke/fixtures/live-bodies/ refreshed. Leaving it costs nothing: it only ever matches a handle that is no longer authored anywhere.

renames.why: The permissions terminal lab teaches CED Topic 4.3 and was filed under Topic 1.2. Renamed through pageUpdate with redirectNewHandle, so Shopify holds a 301 and every inbound link still resolves.
